typesense:trending.greeting:
*This is the Ultimate Site full of every single SCP*
*You can be any role listed below, Which are*
*If a Scientist/Researcher, You study SCPs and bring Class-Ds in the SCPs cell to test them, SCP personnel will help you escort them mostly to make sure they don't try anything, uncooperative, or try to escape*
*If SCP personnel, You will help guard SCP cells, or protect people, and help escort Class-Ds for scientist, and if a breach happens you will help recapture the SCP(s) that escaped, And if sent on a mission you will help capture a newly discovered SCP*
*If a Class-D you were originally a deathrow prisoner for whatever thing you did, but the Foundation 'saved' you, not really actually, you are here to get tested on by the Foundation to see what a SCP they captured does, And if a breach caused by the Chaos Insurgency happens you might be recruited and saved or just killed, Another reason you could've been demoted to Class-D is because you were once a SCP personnel, Scientist in the foundation that broke the rules.*
*If a Chaos Insurgency personnel, you breach the SCP Foundation to capture captive SCPs to use them for whatever use, like using the SCP as a weapon, However if the SCP is too unstable for transport or entirely uncontrollable, or a threat to the operative you kill the SCP*
*If a GOC operative you don't breach the foundation or attack them at all, Instead you kill SCPs that are not captured yet, And if you think that the Foundations method of trying to capture a SCP is not working you kill the SCP, You are basically a rival of the foundation*
*If a SCP you were captured by the foundation for being anomalous human having powers or something thats not human that isn't normal, If you can control your powers and is not hostile you are allowed to roam the foundation, Same thing if your just a anomalous creature that isn't hostile, However if you are hostile or can't control your powers you will stay in your cell.*
*Type your role here:*
